update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.52 - Training Items button retry budget fix
Fixes ----- - Fixed Trackblazer's Shop opening still failing intermittently when the Training Items button wasn't detected on the first frame checked, even after the v5.9.51 fix. The opening flow's retry budget is now bumped to 30 attempts to match the budget already used elsewhere for the same button. - Fixed the per-turn inventory sync dialog failing to open on the first attempt, which could permanently break item usage for the rest of the run until it happened to succeed once. It now retries up to 30 times like the other Training Items button checks.
